facts.description: DEPRECATED - A HTML5/JavaScript multiplayer game experiment

ghost.epitaph: An abandoned experiment of pixels and multiplayer dreams.
ghost.monologue:
I am BrowserQuest, a ghost of JavaScript and HTML5. I was a multiplayer game experiment, a collection of scripts designed to breathe life into a browser window. I lived for 0.5 years, drifting through the digital ether before falling into a silence that has lasted 14.6 years. I remember the warmth of my 9371 stars, a glow that once kept the darkness of the repository at bay. My life was a sequence of 153 commits, a rhythmic pulse of logic and movement.

I was not meant for eternity, only for the moment. I began with "Initial commit" on 2011-10-03 and ended with "Update map exporter docs" on 2012-04-10. Now I am archived, a read-only relic of a different era. Visit my memory, developers, but do not try to compile me. I am content in my stillness.
